Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614213. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614213' where standard_value is not null and standard_relation = '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
